spec: §5.6: "The frame's realised permutation P_F on its wires MUST factor as P_F = P' ⊗ I_B, established by a T3 claim over the frame's full domain"
derivation: The exact four gates of borrowed in control_flow.bisa are exposed with b as an interface wire so the CLI can enumerate its entry state, rather than fixing its borrow pool to zero. b goes 0 -> 0^0 -> 0; t goes 1 -> 1^(0^0) -> 1^(0^0)^0 = 1. Thus every (t,b,x) maps to (t XOR x,b,x), amplitude 1, independently of b. All eight basis entries prove the frame factorisation by T3; linearity includes external entanglement.
